objects.name: ShinyHunters claims it stole 284 million patient records from McKesson
objects.description: Healthcare company McKesson disclosed a cybersecurity incident in which hackers got into third-party applications and stole data. According to the SEC filing, the intrusion was detected on August 25, 2026.
